geometry.locator: bearing computed by this record's author from the beamline's own sourced from_site_id / far_detector_site_ids coordinates
geometry.note: Not a physical structure: CNGS sent neutrinos through the Earth's crust to Gran Sasso, 732 km away, from 2006 to 2012 (now decommissioned). Drawn only as the first 9 km of the beam direction, labelled 'inferred direction'.

method: Great-circle initial bearing from site:cern-meyrin (46.2338702, 6.0469869, the beamline's own recorded from_site_id) toward site:lngs-hall-c (42.4515426, 13.5774421, the far_detector_site_ids far site, the derived underground position of the laboratory), computed on R = 6 371 008.8 m: 122.40 degrees (great-circle distance 731.3 km). Clipped to the map's extent_m (9000 m).
name: CNGS beam direction toward Gran Sasso (inferred)

summary.plain: The initial direction of the CNGS neutrino beam CERN sent toward the Gran Sasso laboratory in Italy, 2006-2012.
